thread:
maria: heads-up — noticed ~1200 orphaned embeddings in eu-west-1 when running the DSAR-delete dry-run. they show as deleted in metadata but vectors still live in the replica index.
kevin: ouch. any errors in the deletion worker logs?
jordan: saw 409s from the vector-store service around 03:14 UTC, plus a couple of KMS decrypt failures. i pulled a snippet:
```
2025-08-22T03:14:07Z ERROR delete-worker: failed remove vector id=... err=KVStore:conflict code=409
2025-08-22T03:14:09Z WARN kms-client: decrypt failed alias=projects/redwood/keys/rs-dsar-rot key_version=2 err=NOT_FOUND
```
lee: hm, KMS NOT_FOUND usually means key alias rotated or policy denies decrypt for the cleanup SA. did we recently change RBAC for the delete-service account?
maria: we rolled a scoped RBAC tweak last week to remove broad kms:Decrypt; intended to be temporary while we audit key usage. looks like the cleanup job needs decrypt to rekey per-region replicas.
sophie (legal): tagging for DSAR impact — if vectors remain after a deletion window that's a compliance risk. we need an ETA for full purge or a retention exception request.
kevin: quick mitigation: re-grant kms:Decrypt to the delete-service principal for the rs-dsar key only, re-run the dry-run with `--force-propagate` and monitor audit logs. can someone do a short lived grant (24h) and we test? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: i can open a temporary IAM change, but want audit proof before we touch keys. audit-bot, can you export all KMS key access events for rs-dsar from Aug 20-23?
audit-bot: scheduled export started. link: https://internal.redwood/audit/exports/exp-20250822-01 (csv)
jordan: also recommend a pre-check script to verify RBAC bindings per-region before delete runs. small quick script: `./scripts/check-kms-bindings.sh rs-dsar delete-service eu-west-1`.
lee: +1. also add a check for replica existence so we don't mark metadata deleted until vectors gone. that will prevent false-positive DSAR completions.
maria: plan: 1) temporary kms:Decrypt grant (kevin) 2) run dry-run + `--force-propagate` (jordan) 3) confirm all orphaned vectors removed (maria/lee) 4) rotate key policy to minimal scope + record in runbook (maria) 5) if any vectors persist, escalate to legal for retention-exception (sophie).
sophie (legal): agree. if you hit >48h to remove we need a retention exception with remediation timeline. please cc me on the incident ticket.
kevin: done — raised IAM change as change-4532, grant set to 24h, audit-only mode enabled.
cleanup-bot: delete-job started for orphaned-embeddings-run-4532, progress: 0/1200.
jordan: i'm kicking off the `--force-propagate` run now. will post results in 10m.
maria: thx all. after this we should add an automated DSAR-safe gate to the CI for any RBAC changes that touch KMS keys used by deletion flows. small follow-up ticket?
lee: created infra ticket #INFRA-1197 to add preflight and an alert if dry-run finds discrepancies.
maria: perfect — let's reconvene if anything fails. :thumbsup:
